music.prompt: Calm, warm and modern instrumental underscore for a short product film about a Mac app that finishes your sentences. Around 92 BPM in D major. Soft felt piano and a gentle electric piano playing slow arpeggios over warm analog pads, a soft round sub bass, very light brushed percussion and a quiet shaker entering after the first few seconds. Hopeful, focused and unhurried, like a quiet morning at a desk. Steady energy throughout with a slight lift in the middle, no drops, no risers, no big hits, no vocals. Leaves plenty of space for a voiceover. Ends on a warm, resolved chord with a natural decay.

Minimal ambient electronic underscore for a calm tech product video. Around 90 BPM. A gentle plucked synth arpeggio and soft mallet bells over a warm pad, a subtle soft pulse, a soft kick on the downbeats after the intro and quiet hi-hat ticks. Optimistic, clean and modern, calm like a product keynote. No vocals, no drops, no risers, no crashes. Leaves plenty of room for narration. Settles into a warm final chord at the end.

Upbeat, energetic modern electronic pop instrumental for a fast, fun launch video about a Mac app that finishes your sentences. 120 BPM in E major. Starts right away, no long intro: a punchy four-on-the-floor kick, claps on two and four, crisp hi-hats and a bouncy synth bass, with bright plucked synth arpeggios and warm chords on top. Confident, optimistic and catchy, with forward momentum the whole way, a small lift around the middle and a clean, satisfying final hit at the end. No vocals, no big drops, no long risers. Leaves room for a voiceover.

Bright, driving indie-electronic instrumental for an upbeat tech product video. 116 BPM. Opens straight into the groove: tight, live-sounding drums with claps, a funky muted electric guitar riff, a round synth bass and sparkly synth plucks. Playful, energetic and modern, like a startup launch film. Keeps moving the whole time, lifts in the second half and ends on a clean button ending. No vocals, no slow intro, no drops. Leaves space for narration.
